name: Jausenstation Tiefenbachklamm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Jausenstation Tiefenbachklamm in Tirol!**

Discover a cozy stopover in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, where fresh mountain air meets hearty local flavors. After exploring the stunning **Tiefenbachklamm gorge**, recharge with traditional **Tiroler specialties** like crispy **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Käsespätzle**, or a steaming bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl**.

Our rustic wooden lodge offers panoramic views of the surrounding peaks, while our friendly team serves up homemade treats and regional drinks—perfect for a well-deserved break on your adventure.

**Come by, relax, and enjoy the taste of Tirol!**
